checks.note: 7 tests pass. Pure virtualization math keeps a 5000-photo collection to <=60 rendered tiles in the tested viewport; media URLs use a 512-entry LRU. TypeScript and Next production build pass.

blocked_gates: UI02 five concurrent live guest sessions and browser timing profile require a deployed production-profile API/object-store environment
Real multipart upload and download-intent browser E2E requires a deployed browser-accessible S3-compatible endpoint and API
RU/BG copy and accessibility require the specified human review
decisions: Protected collection data is fetched client-side with cache:no-store; SSR receives locale and share identifier only
Share secret is accepted only from location.hash, never logged or persisted, and removed with replaceState only after successful exchange
Portal CSRF is kept in sessionStorage; the guest session itself remains an HttpOnly cookie
View, download and upload capabilities are independent; download-only uses an authoritative all-items selection snapshot without listing items
Media URLs are cached only in memory and are evicted before expiry; gallery item state is capped at 300
Multipart upload uses server-issued part URLs in batches of at most 100 and completes with ordered ETags
The lightbox can request and immediately redeem a one-time single-item intent for the first share-allowed preset; the API remains the authority for ready state and current policy.

Gallery no longer truncates the collection at 300 items. It retains up to the required 5000 paged records while rendering only viewport rows plus three-row overscan; thumbnail requests are restricted to that window. Signed media links are bounded by a 512-entry LRU in both cache and React state. P08 functional code is complete and now blocked only by declared deployment/browser/human gates.
